name: Fighting
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of conflict, teaching that strength and skill in fighting can be God-given, as seen in Psalms 144:1. However, Proverbs warns against pride and strife, urging believers to avoid contention before it escalates and to place trust in the Lord rather than stirring up discord. Jesus emphasizes accountability for our words and advocates for reconciliation within the community, instructing believers to address offenses privately to restore relationships (Matthew 12:36; 18:15). Ultimately, Christ’s kingdom transcends earthly battles, reminding us that His followers are called to a different kind of struggle than worldly fighting (John 18:36).
